info.name: Quizzy Phase 2 API
info.description: Run the folders in order: 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 (or use the Collection Runner). Select the "Quizzy Local" environment first. No secrets are stored in this file.

item.name: 1.1 Register student (role in body is ignored)

exec: pm.test("created as STUDENT even though role:teacher was sent",()=>pm.expect(j.data.user.role).to.eql("student"));

item.name: 1.8 Lock + reveal ONE answer (optional step used by the UI)
1.9 Change locked answer -> original stands (no cheating)

exec: pm.test("server computed the score from stored answers",()=>{pm.expect(a.score).to.eql(a.answers.filter(x=>x.correct).length);pm.expect(a.total).to.eql(6);});

pm.test("wrong answers: reps 0, interval 1; right (first time): reps 1, interval 1",()=>j.data.sm2Updates.forEach(u=>{if(u.quality<3){pm.expect(u.reps).to.eql(0);pm.expect(u.interval).to.eql(1);pm.expect(u.lastResult).to.eql("wrong");}else{pm.expect(u.reps).to.eql(1);pm.expect(u.interval).to.eql(1);pm.expect(u.lastResult).to.eql("right");}}));

item.name: 1.11 Submit SAME attempt again -> 409 (no double update)
1.12 Due questions again — persisted SM-2 schedule

exec: pm.test("questions answered wrong are due and come back FIRST",()=>{pm.expect(j.data.selection.due).to.eql(wrong.length);pm.expect(new Set(ids.slice(0,wrong.length))).to.eql(new Set(wrong));});

pm.test("right answers are scheduled in the future (not reselected while fresh ones exist)",()=>{const prev=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("dueQuestionIds"));const right=prev.filter(x=>!wrong.includes(x));right.forEach(id=>pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(id));});

item.name: 1.15 Forged client fields are ignored (all null answers, claims score 6)
